sentiment.summary: Fresh but negative: MSCI finalized its 'non-operating company' index-eligibility rule on Oct 15, putting Strategy on the possible removal list (final list Nov 11, effective Nov 30); MSTR fell 9.6% Friday and 11.3% on the week, with JPMorgan estimating ~$2.8B of outflows if excluded. Partially offsetting: Strategy disclosed +250 BTC ($21.5M) taking holdings to 848,250 BTC, declared November STRC daily dividends ($1.00 total, conditional on the Oct 28 shareholder vote), and Saylor teased more buying Sunday ('We found room for more orange').
